atoms.text: Fabiano sands down a wooden fence so that each piece is of an equal length. He removes 5% of the first piece, 7% of the second, 9% of the third and 3% of the fourth piece.

instruction.text: Is the statement true or false?

atoms.a: Fabiano sands down the most from the second piece.
Fabiano sands down more from the second than from the first piece.

instruction.text: Sort the percentages from largest to smallest.

atoms.text: The Kowalskis have 100 different fruit and vegetable plants in their garden. <mat>1/5</mat> of them are tomatoes, 27% are aubergines, <mat>1/10</mat> are red peppers and 7.5% are cucumbers. Another <mat>1/8</mat> are carrots and a final 23 % are squashes.

instruction.text: Is the statement true or false?

atoms.a: Tomatoes make up the greatest proportion of plants.
They grow more carrots than cucumbers.
Cucumbers make up the smallest proportion of plants.
They grow more red peppers than squashes.

instruction.text: Sort the proportions from largest to smallest.
